name: musubi
description: Musubi monorepo — open, self-hostable shared calendar.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @musubi/design-system typecheck && pnpm --filter @musubi/client exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit --skipLibCheck && pnpm --filter @musubi/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @musubi/design-system test && pnpm --filter @musubi/config test && pnpm --filter @musubi/types test && pnpm --filter @musubi/emails test && pnpm --filter @musubi/auth test && pnpm --filter @musubi/calendar test && pnpm --filter @musubi/client exec tsx lib/eventForm.test.ts && pnpm --filter @musubi/client exec tsx lib/rrule.test.ts && pnpm --filter @musubi/client exec tsx lib/ics.test.ts && pnpm --filter @musubi/client test && pnpm --filter @musubi/api test && pnpm --filter @musubi/db test && pnpm --filter @musubi/web test
scripts.test:db: pnpm test:db:oauth && pnpm test:db:pages && pnpm test:db:scheduling && pnpm test:federation-db && pnpm test:db:federation-gateway && pnpm test:provider-db && pnpm test:db:sync
scripts.check: pnpm release:verify && pnpm check:contracts && pnpm peers:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm build
